errors.text_span: The purple bars (without feature embedding) are generally the second highest, followed by the orange bars (without skip embedding), and the blue bars (without prompt pool) are typically the lowest.
errors.evidence: This statement about the performance ranking of the model variants is an incorrect generalization. For the SMD dataset, the blue bar is higher than the purple bar. For the SMAP dataset, the orange bar is the lowest. For the WADI dataset, the purple bar is the lowest.

On the SMD dataset, the blue bar's value is approximately 92%, visibly higher than the purple bar (approx. 91%). Stating it is 90% is factually incorrect and misrepresents the relative performance within the group.
On the SMD dataset, the green bar is at approximately 93%, not 94%.
The green bar for the WADI dataset has a value of approximately 73%, not 75%. This is a repeated inaccuracy from earlier in the description.
